selection_policy: eligible valid unique instances only; choose one smallest candidate per family first, then round-robin across represented families in deterministic size/path order; reject the selection if the requested count cannot be met
classification_rule: top-level directory name when files are grouped by directory; otherwise known public filename prefixes (us-night, euro-night, london, paris, stars, uniform, sbgdb date/type, many_holes), then normalized filename stem
